supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:56 UTC, Maria Lopez ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-HD-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\maria.lopez\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; Sysmon recorded creation of that archive shortly afterward.

At 13:45:24 UTC, Maria Lopez launched Chrome to sendbox-files.io. At 13:48 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful tunnel to that host with about 51 MB sent from the client; Zeek recorded about 51 MB of originating bytes, and Windows filtering telemetry attributes the proxy connection to Chrome.

The sequence of archiving a Clients share and then sending a similarly large amount of data through Chrome to sendbox-files.io strongly supports suspected data exfiltration. The organization’s inventory says no file-sharing service other than Microsoft 365/OneDrive and cobaltvault.net is approved, and does not list sendbox-files.io.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records a CONNECT tunnel to sendbox-files.io and transfer byte counts, but the available records do not expose the encrypted tunnel’s upload contents or identify the uploaded file. Relevant records: T019-00170, T019-00171.

The evidence shows the archive was created before the large outbound transfer, but does not directly establish that c.zip was the file uploaded or that the transfer contained the archived client data. Relevant records: T019-00117, T019-00119, T019-00170, T019-00171.
claims_not_established: Whether Maria Lopez was authorized to access or transfer the Clients share, or whether the activity was performed with malicious intent.
The exact files and data included in the outbound transfer, and whether c.zip was among them.
The recipient or account that received the data, and whether it was accessed or further shared.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and examine c.zip and relevant filesystem artifacts, including its size, contents, creation metadata, and any evidence of deletion or modification.
Obtain endpoint browser history, download/upload artifacts, and available Chrome process or forensic data to determine what was uploaded to sendbox-files.io.
Request destination-side, proxy, or service-provider records identifying the upload, account, recipient, and subsequent access or sharing.
Confirm with Maria Lopez and the relevant data owner whether access to the Clients share and this transfer were authorized.
